title: Journal entries table schema and migration
description: Define the journal_entries table for user project updates with rich text body, mood tracking, and soft deletion.
acceptanceCriteria: FK to projects.id with cascade delete
mood ENUM: excited, blocked, steady, win, learning
body stored as TEXT (Tiptap JSON serialized as string)
Soft delete via deleted_at nullable timestamp

steps.description: Define mood enum and journal_entries table
steps.details: Create server/src/db/schema/journalEntries.ts. Define journalMoodEnum = pgEnum('journal_mood', ['excited', 'blocked', 'steady', 'win', 'learning']). Define journal_entries table: id (uuid pk), project_id (uuid notNull FK → projects.id cascade delete), title (varchar 500 notNull), body (text notNull — Tiptap JSON as string), mood (journalMoodEnum nullable), created_at (timestamp notNull defaultNow()), updated_at (timestamp notNull defaultNow()), deleted_at (timestamp nullable).

steps.description: Export types and update schema barrel
steps.details: Export type JournalEntry and type NewJournalEntry. Add 'export * from ./journalEntries' to schema/index.ts.
Run 'npm run db:migrate'. Verify journal_entries table exists with all columns and the mood ENUM type.

technicalNotes: Store Tiptap editor content as JSON.stringify(editor.getJSON()) — TEXT is fine for this size
Queries must filter WHERE deleted_at IS NULL to exclude soft-deleted entries
